dialogues.speaker: Zybina
dialogues.text: Tell me, who's happy at work? ...But yes, I've been feeling down. The old sir, our former President... he passed away so suddenly.

dialogues.speaker: Zybina
dialogues.text: I'd been working under him ever since I first started here. Once in a while, when things went sideways at work, he'd actually step in himself to clear up the mess.

dialogues.speaker: Zybina
dialogues.text: *Sniffle* I always thought he'd still be here long after I'm gone, what with him being a fae and all...
